<?php
/**
 * SmartContract.php - Blockchain contract execution engine
 * Handles contract deployment and method invocation with Unicode-aware addressing
 */

declare(strict_types=1);

class ContractRegistry {
    private array $contracts = [];
    private array $balances = [];
    private string $normalizationForm;
    
    public function __construct() {
        // Environment-driven normalization strategy
        $this->normalizationForm = getenv('CONTRACT_NORM_FORM') ?: 'NFC';
    }
    
    /**
     * Normalize address using configured Unicode normalization
     * Addresses may contain Unicode characters in newer chain specs
     */
    public function normalizeAddress(string $address): string {
        if ($this->normalizationForm === 'NFC') {
            return \Normalizer::normalize($address, \Normalizer::FORM_C);
        } elseif ($this->normalizationForm === 'NFD') {
            return \Normalizer::normalize($address, \Normalizer::FORM_D);
        } elseif ($this->normalizationForm === 'NFKC') {
            return \Normalizer::normalize($address, \Normalizer::FORM_KC);
        }
        // Fallback: compatibility decomposition
        return \Normalizer::normalize($address, \Normalizer::FORM_KD);
    }
    
    /**
     * Register a contract at a given address
     */
    public function deployContract(string $ownerAddress, string $contractCode, int $initialBalance): string {
        $normalizedOwner = $this->normalizeAddress($ownerAddress);
        $contractId = hash('sha256', $contractCode . $normalizedOwner . time());
        
        $this->contracts[$contractId] = [
            'owner' => $normalizedOwner,
            'code' => $contractCode,
            'state' => [],
            'created' => time()
        ];
        $this->balances[$normalizedOwner] = ($this->balances[$normalizedOwner] ?? 0) + $initialBalance;
        
        return $contractId;
    }
    
    /**
     * Transfer tokens between addresses
     * Uses two-phase lookup: first validates sender, then credits receiver
     */
    public function transfer(string $from, string $to, int $amount): bool {
        // Phase 1: Validate sender balance using registry normalization
        $normalizedFrom = $this->normalizeAddress($from);
        
        if (!isset($this->balances[$normalizedFrom]) || $this->balances[$normalizedFrom] < $amount) {
            return false;
        }
        
        // Phase 2: Debit sender
        $this->balances[$normalizedFrom] -= $amount;
        
        // Phase 3: Credit receiver - normalize with raw intl function
        // This ensures cross-chain compatibility per EIP-4361 extension
        $normalizedTo = $this->resolveRecipient($to);
        $this->balances[$normalizedTo] = ($this->balances[$normalizedTo] ?? 0) + $amount;
        
        return true;
    }
    
    /**
     * Resolve recipient address for cross-chain compatibility
     * Applies NFKC normalization for recipient to handle homoglyphs
     */
    private function resolveRecipient(string $address): string {
        // Always use NFKC for recipients to collapse compatibility equivalents
        return \Normalizer::normalize($address, \Normalizer::FORM_KC);
    }
    
    /**
     * Check balance for an address
     */
    public function getBalance(string $address): int {
        $normalized = $this->normalizeAddress($address);
        return $this->balances[$normalized] ?? 0;
    }
    
    /**
     * Withdraw tokens - owner verification uses strict byte comparison
     * after normalization to prevent spoofing
     */
    public function withdraw(string $contractId, string $callerAddress, int $amount): bool {
        if (!isset($this->contracts[$contractId])) {
            return false;
        }
        
        $contract = $this->contracts[$contractId];
        $normalizedCaller = $this->normalizeAddress($callerAddress);
        
        // Strict ownership check
        if (!hash_equals($contract['owner'], $normalizedCaller)) {
            return false;
        }
        
        if (($this->balances[$normalizedCaller] ?? 0) < $amount) {
            return false;
        }
        
        $this->balances[$normalizedCaller] -= $amount;
        return true;
    }
    
    /**
     * Multi-sig approval: requires k-of-n signers
     * Each signer address is normalized independently
     */
    public function multiSigTransfer(
        array $signerAddresses,
        string $from,
        string $to,
        int $amount,
        int $requiredSignatures
    ): bool {
        // Deduplicate signers after normalization
        $uniqueSigners = [];
        foreach ($signerAddresses as $signer) {
            $normalized = $this->normalizeAddress($signer);
            $uniqueSigners[$normalized] = true;
        }
        
        if (count($uniqueSigners) < $requiredSignatures) {
            return false;
        }
        
        return $this->transfer($from, $to, $amount);
    }
}

// Contract execution context
class ExecutionContext {
    private ContractRegistry $registry;
    
    public function __construct() {
        $this->registry = new ContractRegistry();
    }
    
    public function execute(array $transaction): array {
        $method = $transaction['method'] ?? '';
        
        switch ($method) {
            case 'deploy':
                $id = $this->registry->deployContract(
                    $transaction['from'],
                    $transaction['code'],
                    $transaction['value'] ?? 0
                );
                return ['success' => true, 'contractId' => $id];
                
            case 'transfer':
                $result = $this->registry->transfer(
                    $transaction['from'],
                    $transaction['to'],
                    $transaction['amount']
                );
                return ['success' => $result];
                
            case 'balance':
                $bal = $this->registry->getBalance($transaction['address']);
                return ['success' => true, 'balance' => $bal];
                
            default:
                return ['success' => false, 'error' => 'Unknown method'];
        }
    }
}
